units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:6">Ukts. II, 6</cite> <he>עד שיִגּוֹס</he> until he has knocked off (a piece of the eggshell).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 3:6">T’bul Yom III, 6</cite> <he>שנגס מן האוכל וכ׳</he> (not <he>שנגוס</he>) who took a bite of some food, and something mixed with his saliva fell on his garments.
